sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The granddaughter of the chief of a therianthropic tribe that lives deep in the forest. Kilika heard from a certain organization of humans that the only way to cure her grandfather's illness was to obtain a special herb located in the sanctuary of the elves. Upon learning this, she crossed into the forbidden elf territory, but was promptly surrounded by very intimidating elven soldiers. Although she tried to explain she was only there to obtain the herb that would help her grandfather, the elven soldiers cursed her kind, igniting a furious rage within her. After beating them to a pulp, she took the herb she needed and fled.
